paite: TOUPA, ka hon sam hi, ka kiang ah hong pai meng inla, ka hon sap in ka aw ah bil na doh in.
heading: David La / Nitaklam Thumna

paite: Ka thumna gimnamtui bang in na ma ah hihkhiak in om henla; ka khut zak nitaklam kithoihna bang in om hen.
TOUPA aw, ka kam bul ah vengmi tusak inla; ka muk kongkhak veng in.
Gilou-salou thil hihkhialmi te hih bang in, thil hoih lou lam ah ka lungtang kiheisak ke'nla; aneklimte uh hon nesak ke'n.
Midiktat in hon sat hen, migitna ahi ding; hon taihilh hen; thau manpha ahi ding a, migilou-salou in ka lutang thaunilh ngei kei hen, anasep giloute hua in ka thum gige hi.
Amau mohpaih dingte kiang a piakkhiak ahih chiang un, TOUPA thu adik chih athei ding uh.
Mi'n lei aleh a, ahihzan bang in aguhte uh han gong ah thehdalh in a-om ding.
TOUPA Pathian aw, ka mit in nang lama-en nak a; nangmah ah ka muanna ka nga a; ka hinna vuaktang in nuse ke'n.
Ka awkna ding a athangkam lak uah hon hum in, thil hihkhialte thang lak ah.
Kei ka suakta ding a, migilou-salou amau len ah awk uhen.
